title: Tel Aviv-based 42AI, which is developing a "behavioral world model" that tries to predict how humans will act, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
summary: Ram Iyer / TechCrunch: Tel Aviv-based 42AI, which is developing a “behavioral world model” that tries to predict how humans will act, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed — Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?
